prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a sample photograph for a Korean classroom image interpolation exercise. Create one natural, believable photograph of an orange tabby cat sitting on a wooden windowsill, with a small green leafy houseplant beside it, and simple window-frame edges and a softly lit garden in the background. Landscape 3:2 composition, cat fully visible in a medium shot, calm daylight, ordinary home snapshot rather than polished advertising. Clearly visible whiskers, fur texture, leaf edges, straight and diagonal wooden edges, and smooth light gradients so different image enlargement methods are easy to compare. No people, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no collage, no UI. Render a normal sharp source photo; this source will subsequently be downsampled to 192 by 128 pixels to create the actual low-resolution practice asset.

processing.method: Pillow LANCZOS resize, JPEG quality 65, optimize true

description_ko: 보간법 비교용 AI 생성 사진. 고해상도 생성 원본을 192x128로 축소한 저해상도 예시.
